'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Vincent Rossi LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Vincent Rossi]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
